target: Integrate published Windows maintenance fixes and local multi-segment capture, then recover verifiable source rewrites without losing raw authority.
invariants: Raw records and completed summaries remain unchanged.
Unresolved WAL transactions are never reported committed.
Excluded subagents never contribute visible dialogue.
New source generations preserve old IDs and use distinct new IDs.
A relocation requires exact unambiguous retained-suffix and token-anchor evidence.
All interrupted relocation writes recover before capture begins.
Cloud ACK, publication, import, and source waterlines remain distinct.
prohibited_changes: Reset source cursors without a hash-bound verification receipt.
Silently remove unavailable historical records or unresolved transactions.
Overwrite unrelated local work or publish a version before its validation gates pass.
before_after_checks: Run source-change isolation, excluded-source shrink, generation-tail and restart regressions.
Run frozen semantic job integrity isolation tests inherited from v2.19.2.
Run the full candidate workflow on macOS, Windows and Ubuntu.
Rehearse the current desktop launcher against the preserved active root before local release completion.
